title: Genetic similarity of a soybean variety to the most similar variety it was compared with, by SNP genotyping on the BARCSoySNP6K panel, computed as in the soybean molecular marker method the USDA Plant Variety Protection Office uses. Slot 0 is the similarity in percent times 100 (94.37 % is 9437): identical SNP calls divided by SNPs called in both. Published by VeilCore (veilcore.org).
